incidente.resumo: A bug introduced in a refactoring of the Code Jam automated email system made a cron job resend a registration notification every minute, so a large number of 2013 registrants received it more than 20 times. The repetition stopped when, after being alerted by a contestant, the team manually stopped the system.

descricao.texto: The repeated sending was reported by a contestant, after which the system was manually stopped.
trechos: That process repeated several dozen times before we were alerted by a contestant, and manually stopped the system.

descricao.texto: The MailCheckWorker cron job looks for notifications with status 'Waiting' and starts sending them, but only marks a notification 'Sent' once all emails have been sent, without marking it 'Sending' when it starts; so a minute after sending started, the job started sending the same notification to everyone again, and this repeated several dozen times.
trechos: We have a cron job called the MailCheckWorker that looks for "Waiting" notifications and starts sending them. Once all emails have been sent, the notification is marked "Sent".

The MailCheckWorker should start sending the notifications and mark them as "Sending". So a minute after we started sending the email to everyone for the first time, the MailCheckWorker started sending it to everyone for the second time.
That process repeated several dozen times before we were alerted by a contestant, and manually stopped the system.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: Smaller-scale tests of the mail system all finished within a minute, so the MailCheckWorker saw a 'Sent' notification and did not start it again, and the bug did not show in testing.
trechos: We had run smaller-scale tests of the mail system, but they all finished within a minute; so the MailCheckWorker just saw a "Sent" notification and didn't start it again.

descricao.texto: A bug was introduced in a refactoring of the Code Jam mail system.
trechos: I'm writing this to apologize: we didn't intend to send anyone more than one email, but a bug crept in to a refactoring of our mail system and ruined those plans.

passos.texto: The mail system was manually stopped after a contestant alerted the team.
trechos: That process repeated several dozen times before we were alerted by a contestant, and manually stopped the system.

acoes.texto: The Code Jam team states it will work hard to make sure this does not happen again.
trechos: On behalf of the Code Jam team and Google, I'm sorry; we'll work hard to make sure this doesn't happen again.

observacoes: The email was titled 'Registration Now Open for Google Code Jam 2014!', but the text gives no date for the incident itself ('A few hours ago'), so data_incidente is null. The text says the MailCheckWorker 'should' mark notifications as 'Sending' but does not say this fix was made.
